evidence_interpretation.narrative: Binary change on the unchanged v0.4.8 argument set (--max-private-continuations 8 --device-state-slots 4 --host-state-slots 24): runtime source d956e6d6 carries three context-cache fixes (a fork inherits the anchor it forks from; consuming an endpoint no longer double-charges a shared anchor; a full anchor set replaces the least valuable anchor instead of the earliest) and the restore path change (payloads hashed once as the engine streams them, x86 SHA extensions, queue-depth-eight io_uring reads overlapped with the hash). Every gate below was measured on 2026-09-08 against a candidate started through tools/lifecycle/ninfer_container.py from the published image (preflight bound image id, binary, model artifact, and configuration identities; the lifecycle receipt is the candidate's own status). Earlier the same day the same gates passed on the same binary bind-mounted into the v0.4.5 image; those runs are superseded by these. Nothing is inherited except the store-format authority and the origin-authentication arc.
